examples.title: Example 1: Displaying Different Types of Popups
examples.description:
This example shows how to configure the keyboardAvoidMode property in PopupOptions or CustomPopupOptions to determine whether the popup avoids the soft keyboard.
The keyboardAvoidMode property is added to PopupOptions and CustomPopupOptions since API version 15.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Popup Text Style
examples.description: In this example, the messageOptions attribute in PopupOptions is configured to display a bubble with a custom text style.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Popup Style
examples.description: This example sets the arrowHeight, arrowWidth, radius, shadow, and popupColor attributes in PopupOptions to implement the style of the bubble arrow and the bubble itself.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Popup Animation
examples.description: This example configures the transition attribute in PopupOptions or CustomPopupOptions to implement the popup animation.

examples.title: Example 5: Adding an Event to a Popup
examples.description: This example shows how to use the onWillDismiss property in PopupOptions to intercept popup dismissal events and execute callback functions.

examples.title: Example 6: Intercepting the Popup Dismissal Event
examples.description: This example demonstrates intercepting the popup dismissal event by setting the onWillDismiss property of PopupOptions to false. In addition, configuring the followTransformOfTarget property in PopupOptions enables setting whether the popup follows and displays at the corresponding position when the host component's position is transformed.

examples.title: Example 7: Setting the Linear Gradient for the Inner and Outer Outlines of a Popup
examples.description:
This example configures the outlineWidth, borderWidth, outlineLinearGradient, and borderLinearGradient attributes in PopupOptions to set the color and direction of the linear gradient of the inner and outer strokes of the bubble.
The outlineWidth, borderWidth, outlineLinearGradient, and borderLinearGradient attributes are added to PopupOptions since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 8: Setting the Avoid Host Mode for Bubbles
examples.description:
This example configures the avoidTarget attribute of PopupOptions to make the bubble avoid the bound component.
The avoidTarget attribute is added to PopupOptions since API version 20.
